strings.Parle à Nagache devant le relais des Gém: Talk to Rensa outside Dueling Peaks Stable and accept the horse-taming challenge.
strings.Parle à Tabos au relais de l'Orée de la: Talk to Toffa at Outskirt Stable, then look for the white horse on Safula Hill.
strings.Quitte le plateau avec la paravoile et d: Leave the plateau with the Paraglider and head toward Dueling Peaks.

strings.Nano Gardien - Épreuve majeure de force: Guardian Scout IV - A Major Test of Strength
strings.Parle à Della au village Piaf et écoute: Talk to Bedoli in Rito Village and listen to the unfinished song, then ask her sister for the final verse.
strings.Parle à Onag puis à Manny près de l'aube: Talk to Prima, then Manny near the inn in Hateno Village.
strings.Parle à Onag puis à Hamel près de l'aube: Talk to Prima, then Manny near the inn in Hateno Village.
strings.Demande à Onag ce qu'elle aime et appren: Ask Prima what she likes; she tells you that she wants one hundred Restless Crickets.
strings.Retrouve Palme, Florette, Canolo et Olif: Find Palme, Flaxel, Canolo and Oliff at the Bokoblin camp on Koukot Plateau.
strings.Combat DLC scénarisé unique pour la réco: One-time DLC story battle for the reward; a rematch does not award another Master Cycle Zero.
strings.Après la libération des quatre Créatures: After freeing all four Divine Beasts, return to the Shrine of Resurrection and take the One-Hit Obliterator.
strings.Active la carte, fais pivoter la Créatur: Activate the map, rotate the Divine Beast to reach its five terminals, then defeat Fireblight Ganon and return to Bludo.
strings.Active la carte, ouvre les cinq terminau: Activate the map, tilt the Divine Beast to access its five terminals, then defeat Windblight Ganon and speak to Kaneli again.
strings.Active la carte, règle la trompe et la r: Activate the map, adjust the trunk and wheel to access its five terminals, then defeat Waterblight Ganon and return to King Dorephan.
strings.Bats Ganon, le Fléau, puis chevauche aut: Defeat Calamity Ganon, then ride around Dark Beast Ganon and shoot its glowing weak points with the Bow of Light.
strings.Apporte trois vis antiques pour Bombes +: Bring three Ancient Screws for Remote Bomb+, three Ancient Shafts for Stasis+ and three Ancient Cores for Sheikah Sensor+.
strings.Obtiens Polaris, Bombes à distance, Cryo: Obtain Magnesis, Remote Bomb, Cryonis and Stasis in the four Great Plateau shrines.
strings.Active la carte, aligne les circuits des: Activate the map, align the circuits in the three cylinders to open the five terminals, then defeat Thunderblight Ganon and return to Riju.
strings.Affiche la carte de la tablette Sheikah: Open the Sheikah Slate map and activate Hero's Path Mode.
strings.Dans la dernière salle, utilise les bloc: In the final room, use the blocks as both steps and an electrical circuit. Connect the circuit without electrifying the block you climb on.
strings.Observe les motifs, constellations, ombr: Observe the patterns, constellations, shadows or light sources and reproduce their order using the switches.
strings.Place un pilier entre vous lorsqu'il cha: Keep a pillar between you and the Guardian Scout during its spinning charge. The collision gives you time to attack.
strings.Tire dans l'œil pour interrompre le lase: Shoot its eye to interrupt the laser, then attack while it is stunned.
strings.Traverse les pièges, élimine les Nano Ga: Pass the traps, defeat the Guardian Scouts, and use fire, balls and launchers to open the next sections.
strings.Lis ses trois armes : salto arrière cont: Watch its three weapons: backflip to dodge horizontal swings, and dodge sideways to avoid overhead strikes or thrusts.
strings.Parle à la statue à cornes sous le pont,: Speak to the Horned Statue beneath the bridge at the entrance to Hateno Village, and let it take a Heart Container or Stamina Vessel.
strings.Place-toi sur l'ascenseur avant que la s: Stand on the elevator before the sphere reaches its socket, then ride up to the altar.
strings.Fige la première sphère lorsqu'elle pass: Freeze the first sphere as it passes the socket, then shoot an arrow to knock it into the socket.
strings.Fige la première sphère, vise légèrement: Freeze the first sphere, aim along its intended path, and strike it about five times with a hammer to reach the socket.
strings.Frappe son ventre pendant l'étourdisseme: Attack its belly while it is stunned, but watch out: it recovers faster than an ordinary Molduga.
strings.Porte la dernière sphère sur le tapis ro: Carry the last sphere onto the conveyor belt. Move behind the blocks that shield you from the lasers, then place it in its socket.
strings.Première partie : exploite les pouvoirs: First phase: use the powers of the freed Divine Beasts, dodge its weapons, and aim at its eye whenever you have an opening.
strings.Profite de l'étourdissement pour grimper: Climb onto it while it is stunned. Without cooling it first, contact continually causes damage.
strings.Prépare une attaque renforcée, vise l'œi: Prepare an attack boost, aim at its eye, and use your strongest weapons while it is stunned.
strings.Phase 2 : élimine rapidement les clones: Phase 2: quickly defeat the clones. The real monk keeps his health bar and remains the target of your lock-on.
strings.Emporte la coupelle dans la seconde sall: Carry the scoop into the second room, place a sphere above the cage, then activate the submerged mechanism.
strings.Décoche une seule flèche à travers les d: Shoot a single arrow through both rings to reveal Sheem Dagoze Shrine.
strings.Décoche une flèche électrique au centre: Shoot a Shock Arrow into the center of the marked target to reveal Keeha Yoog Shrine.
strings.Ajuste ta position jusqu'à ce que le soc: Adjust your position until the pedestal activates and reveals Suma Sahma Shrine.
strings.Réceptacle de cœur, Colère d'Urbosa et l: Heart Container, Urbosa's Fury, and the liberation of Vah Naboris
strings.Réceptacle de cœur, Rage de Revali et li: Heart Container, Revali's Gale, and the liberation of Vah Medoh
strings.Vise l'œil pour interrompre le laser et: Aim at its eye to interrupt the laser, then attack whenever it is stunned.
strings.Parle à Sasan lorsque la lettre atteint: Speak to Sasan when the letter reaches Mercay Island and then meets Sasan and Finley at the Zora's Domain.
strings.Salle 10 - Salle active - 1 Hinox noir :: Room 10 - Combat room - 1 Black Hinox: Prepare an attack boost, aim at its eye, and use your strongest weapons while it is stunned.
strings.Salle 14 - Salle active - 2 Chuchus de g: Room 14 - Combat room - 2 Ice Chuchus, 1 Ice-Breath Lizalfos, 4 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Silver Moblin: Defeat the ice enemies with fire and collect the three Ancient Arrows from the chest.
strings.Salle 2 - Salle active - 2 Chauves-souri: Room 2 - Combat room - 2 Electric Keese, 3 Stalizalfos: Defeat the Keese, detonate the barrels with a bomb, and quickly destroy the skulls.
strings.Salle 22 - Salle active - 1 Gardien à pi: Room 22 - Combat room - 1 Guardian Stalker, 1 Guardian Skywatcher, 1 Guardian Turret: Defeat the Guardian Skywatcher and Guardian Stalker with Ancient Arrows, then climb to the Guardian Turret if necessary.
strings.Après Vah'Ruta, parle à Fronk au domaine: After Vah Ruta, talk to Fronk at the Zora's Domain.
strings.Après Vah'Ruta, parle à Laruta au domain: After Vah Ruta, talk to Laruta at the Zora's Domain and then to Trello near the square.
strings.Parle à Jitah au domaine Zora et photogr: Talk to Jiahto at the Zora's Domain and photograph the repaired monument.
strings.Parle à Laflat au domaine Zora après avo: Talk to Laflat at the Zora's Domain after getting the camera.
strings.Parle à Ledo près de l'entrée du domaine: Speak to Ledo near the entrance to the Zora's Domain.
strings.Parle à Torfeau au domaine Zora et rense: Speak to Torfeau at the Zora's Domain and inquire about the Hinox of the pond of Ralis.
strings.Rejoins le domaine Zora, parle au roi Do: Join the Zora's Domain, talk to King Dorephan and get the Zora armor.
strings.Remonte le chemin du domaine Zora en sui: Walk up the path of the Zora's Domain following signs and encounters with Sidon; avoid slippery walls in the rain.
strings.Retourne voir Jitah après la lecture des: Return to Jiahto after reading the ten remaining monuments.
strings.Parle à Jitato au domaine Zora et photog: Speak to Jiahto at Zora's Domain and photograph the repaired monument.
strings.Parle à Jitato au domaine zora et photog: Speak to Jiahto at Zora's Domain and photograph the repaired monument.
strings.Retourne voir Jitato après la lecture de: Return to Jiahto after reading the ten remaining monuments.
strings.Parle à Poréa au domaine Zora et renseig: Speak to Torfeau at Zora's Domain and ask about the Hinox at Ralis Pond.
Speak to Torfeau at Zora's Domain and ask about the Hinox at Ralis Pond.
strings.Parle à Poréa au domaine zora et renseig: Speak to Torfeau at Zora's Domain and ask about the Hinox at Ralis Pond.
strings.Retourne voir Poréa pour annoncer la vic: Return to Torfeau to report your victory.
strings.Abats d'abord le Sorcier pour éviter ses: Defeat the Wizzrobe first to prevent reinforcements, then use its fire weapon as a light source.
strings.Abats le Sorcier avec le feu avant qu'il: Defeat the Wizzrobe with fire before it summons reinforcements, then isolate the larger enemies.
strings.Approche accroupi pour capturer la fée,: Approach while crouching to catch the fairy, break the crates, and cook the ingredients before leaving.
strings.Approche discrètement, neutralise d'abor: Approach quietly, defeat the archers first, and detonate the barrels from a safe position.
strings.Capture la fée, ouvre les trois coffres: Catch the fairy, open the three chests, and cook before entering the dark section.
strings.Capture les deux fées et conserve précie: Catch the two fairies and save the three Ancient Arrows for the final rooms.
strings.Capture les deux fées, ouvre les trois c: Catch the two fairies, open the three chests, and cook all the useful food.
strings.Capture les quatre fées, cuisine un repa: Catch the four fairies, cook a meal that fully restores health, and open the three chests containing Royal weapons.
strings.Capture les trois fées, ouvre les coffre: Catch the three fairies, open the chests, and cook several cold-resistant meals for the next section.
strings.Concentre les attaques sur les modèles I: Focus your attacks on the Guardian Scout II enemies, and use the pillars to block their lines of fire.
strings.Coupe ses pattes, vise l'œil et combats-: Cut off its legs, aim at its eye, and fight it normally to save your Ancient Arrows.
strings.Crée un pilier Cryonis pour tirer en ral: Create a Cryonis pillar to shoot in slow motion, then focus all your attacks on one target at a time.
strings.Dans l'obscurité, repère les lueurs, éli: In the dark, look for glowing enemies. Defeat the Keese from a distance, then the Chuchu.
strings.Décroche son œil, détruis-le avant l'aub: Knock out its eye, destroy it before dawn, and collect the three elemental weapons attached to its body.
strings.Déplace la caisse métallique pour attein: Move the metal crate to reach the hidden chest, then defeat the Guardians without wasting your strongest weapons.
strings.Détruis ses bras avec les bombes, grimpe: Destroy its arms with bombs, climb onto it when it falls, and strike the ore deposit with a two-handed weapon.
strings.Examine le moine : l'Épée de légende con: Examine the monk: the Master Sword now permanently retains its base attack power of 60.
strings.Examine le moine pour renforcer l'Épée d: Examine the monk to strengthen the Master Sword to a base attack power of 40.
Examine the monk to strengthen the Master Sword to a base attack power of 50.
strings.Fais exploser les Chuchus à distance et: Blast the Chuchus from a distance and use the updrafts before the grass stops burning.
strings.Fais exploser les Chuchus à distance pui: Blast the Chuchus from a distance, then use bombs to disarm and finish off the Stalmoblins.
strings.Fais fondre sa glace, utilise le brise-p: Melt its ice, use the Stone Smasher from the rest room, and strike the ore deposit.
strings.Isole les éclaireurs et utilise Cryonis: Isolate the Guardian Scouts and use Cryonis to reach the chest containing ten arrows.
strings.La neige gêne les déplacements : utilise: Snow makes movement difficult: use an Ancient Arrow to conserve health and equipment.
strings.Laisse les bombes flotter sous les plate: Let bombs float beneath the platforms to save weapon durability, then open the chest on the right.
strings.Neutralise le Sorcier en premier et cons: Defeat the Wizzrobe first and keep its Meteor Rod for the cold section.
strings.Place un obstacle entre le laser et Link: Keep an obstacle between the laser and Link, aim at its eye, then attack while the laser is interrupted.
strings.Prends de la hauteur avec les tours, dét: Climb the towers to gain height, destroy its propellers, or use an Ancient Arrow.
strings.Provoque les esquives parfaites et abrit: Perform perfect dodges and take cover when the spinning attack begins.
strings.Refroidis son corps avec la glace, explo: Cool its body with ice, use the updrafts, and strike the ore deposit.
strings.Repère son œil dans l'obscurité, protège: Find its eye in the dark, take cover behind the scenery, and reflect or interrupt its laser.
strings.Reste à distance : les bombes suffisent: Keep your distance: bombs are enough to clear this entire volcanic room.
strings.Supprime immédiatement le Lynel avec une: Immediately defeat the Lynel with an Ancient Arrow, defeat the Guardian Turret, then finish off the mounted enemies.
strings.Tire une flèche de feu dans la grotte-cr: Shoot a Fire Arrow into the skull cave, then bombard the survivors from the trees.
strings.Tue l'Octo placé derrière le départ, sor: Defeat the Octorok behind the starting point, lift the chest with Cryonis, then keep the Wizzrobe on the ground.
strings.Utilise Cinetis et l'électricité ; empêc: Use Stasis and electricity. Keep the Moblins from falling into the lava so you can collect their weapons.
strings.Utilise l'arbre comme couvert, puis une: Use the tree as cover, then detonate a bomb near the fire. Immediately collect the weapons and food.
strings.Utilise la glace contre les crache-feu e: Use ice against the fire-breathing enemies, and fight one target at a time in the lit area.
strings.Utilise le feu contre les ennemis gelés: Use fire against frozen enemies and make use of the final cooking pot.
strings.Utilise les arbres pour couper les tirs,: Use the trees to block incoming shots, attack each Guardian from behind, and save your Ancient Arrows.
strings.Utilise les courants ascendants pour vis: Use the updrafts to aim at their heads, then defeat them with the ice weapon.
strings.Utilise les courants d'air pour les tirs: Use the updrafts to shoot in slow motion and knock enemies off the platforms.
strings.Utilise surtout les bombes, détruis les: Mostly use bombs, destroy the skulls, and save all wooden weapons for later.
strings.Vise l'œil, exploite Cinetis amélioré et: Aim at its eye, use Stasis+, and strike it with a two-handed weapon whenever it falls.
strings.Vole un cheval squelette, saute pour tir: Steal a Stalhorse, jump to shoot in slow motion, and aim at the mounted enemies' heads.
strings.Économise une arme solide, exploite chaq: Save a durable weapon, use each perfect dodge, and ride the updrafts from the rotating laser.
strings.Élimine le Chuchu depuis le grand arbre,: Defeat the Chuchu from the tall tree, then use bombs to dislodge the archers one at a time.
strings.Élimine le Chuchu depuis le rocher, sais: Defeat the Chuchu from the rock, grab the spear, and isolate the Lizalfos with Stasis.
strings.Élimine le volant et le marcheur aux flè: Defeat the Guardian Skywatcher and Guardian Stalker with Ancient Arrows, then climb to the Guardian Turret if necessary.
strings.Élimine les Chauves-souris, déclenche le: Defeat the Keese, detonate the barrels with a bomb, and quickly destroy the skulls.
strings.Élimine les Sorciers à l'arc avant qu'il: Defeat the Wizzrobes with arrows before they change the weather, then finish off the Bokoblins.
strings.Élimine les archers avant d'avancer avec: Defeat the archers before advancing on the raft, and knock the Moblin into the water if possible.
strings.Élimine les cibles de glace avec le feu: Defeat the ice enemies with fire and collect the three Ancient Arrows from the chest.
strings.Salle 1 - Salle active - 3 Bokoblins : U: Room 1 - Combat room - 3 Bokoblins: Use the tree as cover, then detonate a bomb near the fire. Immediately collect the weapons and food.
strings.Salle 1 - Salle active - 4 Stalkoblins :: Room 1 - Combat room - 4 Stalkoblins: Mostly use bombs, destroy the skulls, and save all wooden weapons for later.
strings.Salle 1 - Salle active - 5 Bokoblins : L: Room 1 - Combat room - 5 Bokoblins: Let bombs float beneath the platforms to save weapon durability, then open the chest on the right.
strings.Salle 10 - Salle active - 1 Lézalfos ble: Room 10 - Combat room - 1 Blue Lizalfos, 2 Black Lizalfos: Create a Cryonis pillar to shoot in slow motion, then focus all your attacks on one target at a time.
strings.Salle 10 - Salle active - 3 Moblins noir: Room 10 - Combat room - 3 Black Moblins, 1 Fire-Breath Lizalfos: Use Stasis and electricity. Keep the Moblins from falling into the lava so you can collect their weapons.
strings.Salle 11 - Salle active - 1 Magrok : Ref: Room 11 - Combat room - 1 Igneo Talus: Cool its body with ice, use the updrafts, and strike the ore deposit.
strings.Salle 11 - Salle active - 4 Bokoblins, 3: Room 11 - Combat room - 4 Bokoblins, 3 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Black Bokoblin, 1 Black Moblin: Defeat the archers before advancing on the raft, and knock the Moblin into the water if possible.
strings.Salle 11 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Capt: Room 11 - Rest room - None: Catch the two fairies, open the three chests, and cook all the useful food.
strings.Salle 12 - Salle active - 1 Hinox bleu :: Room 12 - Combat room - 1 Blue Hinox: Aim at its eye, use Stasis+, and strike it with a two-handed weapon whenever it falls.
strings.Salle 12 - Salle active - 6 Nano Gardien: Room 12 - Combat room - 6 Guardian Scouts I: Isolate the Guardian Scouts and use Cryonis to reach the chest containing ten arrows.
strings.Salle 12 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Capt: Room 12 - Rest room - None: Catch the three fairies, open the chests, and cook several cold-resistant meals for the next section.
strings.Salle 13 - Salle active - 2 Lithoroks ju: Room 13 - Combat room - 2 Frost Pebblits, 1 Ice Chuchu, 2 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Black Bokoblin: Use fire against frozen enemies and make use of the final cooking pot.
strings.Salle 13 - Salle active - 3 Nano Gardien: Room 13 - Combat room - 3 Guardian Scouts II: Move the metal crate to reach the hidden chest, then defeat the Guardians without wasting your strongest weapons.
strings.Salle 13 - Salle de récompense - Aucun :: Room 13 - Reward Room - None: Examine the monk to strengthen the Master Sword to a base attack power of 40.
strings.Salle 14 - Salle active - 4 Nano Gardien: Room 14 - Combat room - 4 Guardian Scouts I, 2 Guardian Scouts II: Focus your attacks on the Guardian Scout II enemies, and use the pillars to block their lines of fire.
strings.Salle 15 - Salle active - 1 Moblin noir,: Room 15 - Combat room - 1 Black Moblin, 1 Ice Wizzrobe, 2 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Silver Bokoblin: Defeat the Wizzrobe with fire before it summons reinforcements, then isolate the larger enemies.
strings.Salle 15 - Salle active - 2 Nano Gardien: Room 15 - Combat room - 2 Guardian Scouts III: Perform perfect dodges and take cover when the spinning attack begins.
strings.Salle 16 - Salle active - 1 Cryorok : Fa: Room 16 - Combat room - 1 Frost Talus: Melt its ice, use the Stone Smasher from the rest room, and strike the ore deposit.
strings.Salle 16 - Salle active - 1 Nano Gardien: Room 16 - Combat room - 1 Guardian Scout IV: Save a durable weapon, use each perfect dodge, and ride the updrafts from the rotating laser.
strings.Salle 17 - Salle active - 1 Lynel bleu :: Room 17 - Combat room - 1 Blue-Maned Lynel: Snow makes movement difficult: use an Ancient Arrow to conserve health and equipment.
strings.Salle 17 - Salle de récompense - Aucun :: Room 17 - Reward Room - None: Examine the monk to strengthen the Master Sword to a base attack power of 50.
strings.Salle 18 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Capt: Room 18 - Rest room - None: Catch the four fairies, cook a meal that fully restores health, and open the three chests containing Royal weapons.
strings.Salle 19 - Salle active - 6 Gardiens dét: Room 19 - Combat room - 6 Decayed Guardians: Use the trees to block incoming shots, attack each Guardian from behind, and save your Ancient Arrows.
strings.Salle 2 - Salle active - 1 Chuchu de feu: Room 2 - Combat room - 1 Fire Chuchu, 4 Bokoblins: Defeat the Chuchu from the tall tree, then use bombs to dislodge the archers one at a time.
strings.Salle 2 - Salle active - 2 Bokoblins, 1: Room 2 - Combat room - 2 Bokoblins, 1 Blue Bokoblin, 1 Fire Wizzrobe, 2 Meteo Wizzrobes: Defeat the Wizzrobes with arrows before they change the weather, then finish off the Bokoblins.
strings.Salle 20 - Salle active - 1 Gardien à pi: Room 20 - Combat room - 1 Guardian Stalker: Cut off its legs, aim at its eye, and fight it normally to save your Ancient Arrows.
strings.Salle 21 - Salle active - 1 Gardien vola: Room 21 - Combat room - 1 Guardian Skywatcher: Climb the towers to gain height, destroy its propellers, or use an Ancient Arrow.
strings.Salle 23 - Salle active - 8 Bokoblins mo: Room 23 - Combat room - 8 mounted Bokoblins, 1 White-Maned Lynel, 1 Guardian Turret: Immediately defeat the Lynel with an Ancient Arrow, defeat the Guardian Turret, then finish off the mounted enemies.
strings.Salle 24 - Salle de récompense - Aucun :: Room 24 - Reward Room - None: Examine the monk: the Master Sword now permanently retains its base attack power of 60.
strings.Salle 3 - Salle active - 1 Chuchu, 8 Chu: Room 3 - Combat room - 1 Chuchu, 8 Fire Chuchus: Blast the Chuchus from a distance and use the updrafts before the grass stops burning.
strings.Salle 3 - Salle active - 2 Chuchus élect: Room 3 - Combat room - 2 Electric Chuchus, 5 Stalmoblins: Blast the Chuchus from a distance, then use bombs to disarm and finish off the Stalmoblins.
strings.Salle 3 - Salle active - 4 Bokoblins, 3: Room 3 - Combat room - 4 Bokoblins, 3 Blue Bokoblins: Use the updrafts to shoot in slow motion and knock enemies off the platforms.
strings.Salle 4 - Salle active - 1 Gardien détér: Room 4 - Combat room - 1 Decayed Guardian: Keep an obstacle between the laser and Link, aim at its eye, then attack while the laser is interrupted.
strings.Salle 4 - Salle active - 5 Bokoblins, 3: Room 4 - Combat room - 5 Bokoblins, 3 Blue Bokoblins: Approach quietly, defeat the archers first, and detonate the barrels from a safe position.
strings.Salle 4 - Salle active - 7 Stalkoblins m: Room 4 - Combat room - 7 Stalkoblins mounted: Steal a Stalhorse, jump to shoot in slow motion, and aim at the mounted enemies' heads.
strings.Salle 5 - Salle active - 1 Stalhinox : D: Room 5 - Combat room - 1 Stalnox: Knock out its eye, destroy it before dawn, and collect the three elemental weapons attached to its body.
strings.Salle 5 - Salle active - 2 Moblins, 3 Bo: Room 5 - Combat room - 2 Moblins, 3 Blue Bokoblins: Shoot a Fire Arrow into the skull cave, then bombard the survivors from the trees.
strings.Salle 5 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Captu: Room 5 - Rest room - None: Catch the fairy, open the three chests, and cook before entering the dark section.
strings.Salle 6 - Salle active - 1 Lithorok : Dé: Room 6 - Combat room - 1 Stone Talus: Destroy its arms with bombs, climb onto it when it falls, and strike the ore deposit with a two-handed weapon.
strings.Salle 6 - Salle active - 5 Chauves-souri: Room 6 - Combat room - 5 Fire Keese, 1 Electric Chuchu: In the dark, look for glowing enemies. Defeat the Keese from a distance, then the Chuchu.
strings.Salle 6 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Captu: Room 6 - Rest room - None: Catch the two fairies and save the three Ancient Arrows for the final rooms.
strings.Salle 7 - Salle active - 1 Chuchu de feu: Room 7 - Combat room - 1 Fire Chuchu, 1 Rock Octorok, 2 Igneo Pebblits: Keep your distance: bombs are enough to clear this entire volcanic room.
strings.Salle 7 - Salle active - 2 Lézalfos crac: Room 7 - Combat room - 2 Fire-Breath Lizalfos, 2 Blue Lizalfos: Use ice against the fire-breathing enemies, and fight one target at a time in the lit area.
strings.Salle 7 - Salle de repos - Aucun : Appro: Room 7 - Rest room - None: Approach while crouching to catch the fairy, break the crates, and cook the ingredients before leaving.
strings.Salle 8 - Salle active - 1 Sorcier météo: Room 8 - Combat room - 1 Meteo Wizzrobe, 2 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Black Bokoblin: Defeat the Wizzrobe first to prevent reinforcements, then use its fire weapon as a light source.
strings.Salle 8 - Salle active - 1 gros Chuchu é: Room 8 - Combat room - 1 large Electric Chuchu, 2 Lizalfos, 2 Blue Lizalfos: Defeat the Chuchu from the rock, grab the spear, and isolate the Lizalfos with Stasis.
strings.Salle 8 - Salle active - 3 Lézalfos crac: Room 8 - Combat room - 3 Fire-Breath Lizalfos: Use the updrafts to aim at their heads, then defeat them with the ice weapon.
strings.Salle 9 - Salle active - 1 Gardien détér: Room 9 - Combat room - 1 Decayed Guardian: Find its eye in the dark, take cover behind the scenery, and reflect or interrupt its laser.
strings.Salle 9 - Salle active - 1 Sorcier météo: Room 9 - Combat room - 1 Meteo Wizzrobe, 1 Black Moblin, 2 Fire-Breath Lizalfos: Defeat the Wizzrobe first and keep its Meteor Rod for the cold section.
strings.Salle 9 - Salle active - 2 Octos d'eau,: Room 9 - Combat room - 2 Water Octoroks, 1 Electric Wizzrobe: Defeat the Octorok behind the starting point, lift the chest with Cryonis, then keep the Wizzrobe on the ground.
strings.Parle à Jitah au domaine zora et photogr: Speak to Jiahto at Zora's Domain and photograph the repaired monument.
strings.Actionne le cristal, emprunte le passage: Activate the crystal, take the side passage, and collect the Small Key.
strings.Ajuste la trompe sur la carte, utilise C: Adjust the trunk using the map, use Cryonis or Magnesis as needed in each room, and collect the chest before changing the configuration.
strings.Aligne les trois cylindres pour créer le: Align the three cylinders to create a passage or circuit, then use Magnesis and the electrical connections around the chest.
strings.Allume, propage ou protège les flammes n: Light, spread or protect the necessary flames. Use Fire Arrows and block the water flow if needed.
strings.Attends environ 15 h puis place-toi sur: Wait until about 3:00 PM, then stand on the pedestal when the tower's shadow passes over it.
strings.Attends qu'elle cuisine la soupe de légu: Wait for her to cook the vegetable soup, then accept the dish.
strings.Brise la paroi friable derrière la casca: Break the cracked wall behind the waterfall and open all the chests in Misko's cache.
strings.Brise la paroi puis ouvre le coffre cont: Break the wall, then open the chest containing the Drillshaft.
strings.Comme il ne peut pas se déplacer, utilis: Since it cannot move, attack from a distance or reflect its laser with a Perfect Guard.
strings.Depuis le socle, tire une flèche à trave: From the pedestal, shoot an arrow through the heart when the light illuminates it to reveal Bareeda Naag Shrine.
strings.Fige et frappe le bloc afin d'incliner l: Freeze and strike the block to tilt the seesaw, then climb while you have an opening.
strings.Incline Medoh pour déplacer nacelles et: Tilt Vah Medoh to move its gondolas and platforms, then use the updrafts and Paraglider to reach the chest.
strings.L'Expansion Pass doit être détecté ; le: The Expansion Pass must be detected; Master Mode uses a separate save.
strings.Pendant l'attaque laser rotative, utilis: During the rotating laser attack, use the updraft to shoot in slow motion or stay out of range.
strings.Plane vers le pilier rocheux dont l'ombr: Glide toward the rock pillar whose shadow points to the chest, then open the cache.
strings.Plane vers la congère en forme d'oiseau: Glide toward the bird-shaped snowdrift and break the cracked wall to enter Mozo Shenno Shrine.
strings.Pousse le rocher ou utilise Cinetis et d: Push the rock, or use Stasis and strikes to knock it into the hole.
strings.Quand il protège son œil sous la moitié: When it covers its eye below half health, shoot during its attack or use Stasis+.
strings.Rejoins le vieil homme après l'activatio: Meet the Old Man after activating the tower and complete Oman Au Shrine.
strings.Survis à la dernière manche avec une pro: Survive the final round with sufficient flame protection to reveal Joloo Nah Shrine.
strings.Tire ensuite sur une corne, ramasse l'éc: Then shoot a horn, collect the horn shard, and offer it at the Spring of Wisdom to open Jitan Sa'mi Shrine.
strings.Utilise une feuille Korogu pour souffler: Use a Korok Leaf to blow air through the stone pillars in the order from the song to reveal Voo Lota Shrine.
strings.Valide le motif symétrique puis récupère: Complete the symmetrical pattern, then collect the Korok Seed from the Korok.
strings.À faible vie, utilise le courant ascenda: When its health is low, use the updraft from its rotating laser to shoot in slow motion.
strings.À son réveil, vise l'œil : la touche le: When it wakes up, aim at its eye. A hit knocks it down and gives you time to attack.
strings.À très basse santé, interromps ou évite: When its health is very low, interrupt or avoid its charged laser, then finish the fight and open the chest.
strings.1 Sorcier météore, 1 Moblin noir, 2 Léza: 1 Meteo Wizzrobe, 1 Black Moblin, 2 Fire-Breath Lizalfos
strings.1 Sorcier météore, 2 Bokoblins bleus, 1: 1 Meteo Wizzrobe, 2 Blue Bokoblins, 1 Black Bokoblin
strings.2 Bokoblins, 1 Bokoblin bleu, 1 Sorcier: 2 Bokoblins, 1 Blue Bokoblin, 1 Fire Wizzrobe, 2 Meteo Wizzrobes
strings.Atteins l'extrémité de la chaîne de stat: Reach the end of the chain of statues and activate Kema Zoos Shrine.
strings.Atteins la salle centrale et active le s: Reach the central room and activate Dila Maag Shrine.
strings.Atteins le sommet dans les conditions de: Reach the top in the conditions required to reveal Gorae Torr Shrine.
strings.Bats le Hinox, récupère l'orbe à son cou: Beat the Hinox, retrieve the orb around his neck and place it in the base to reveal Ketoh Wawai Shrine.
strings.Bats le record de 1 min 30 s pour recevo: Beat the record of 1 min 30 s to receive the orb, then place it in the base of Raqa Zunzo Shrine.
strings.Conduis le cerf sur le socle près de Asa: Drive the deer on the base near Kass to reveal Mezza Lo Shrine.
strings.Descends dans la salle intérieure et act: Go down into the inner room and activate Tu Ka'loh Shrine.
strings.Décoche une flèche vers le soleil depuis: Shoot an arrow towards the sun from the base to reveal Sasa Kai Shrine.
strings.Dépose l'écaille dans l'eau devant la st: Place the scale in the water in front of the statue of the Goddess to open the passage to Shae Katha Shrine.
strings.Dépose la griffe dans l'eau devant la st: Place the claw in the water in front of the statue to open access to Tutsuwa Nima Shrine.
strings.Lis le message du dernier moine puis tél: Read the message of the last monk and teleport to Ta'loh Naeg Shrine.
strings.Place chaque orbe dans le socle portant: Place each orb in the base bearing the corresponding symbol to reveal Korsh O'hu Shrine.
strings.Place chaque orbe devant la colonne de l: Place each orb in front of the column of the same color to reveal Toh Yahsa Shrine.
strings.Place l'orbe dans le socle au centre de: Place the orb in the base in the center of the spiral to bring out Ritaag Zumo Shrine.
strings.Place le dernier orbe pour révéler le sa: Place the last orb to reveal Korgu Chideh Shrine and automatically retrieve your inventory.
strings.Porte l'orbe jusqu'au socle voisin afin: Take the orb to the nearby base to reveal Shoqa Tatone Shrine.
strings.Poursuis seul jusqu'au grand bouton flor: Pursue alone to the large floral bud behind Ta'loh Naeg Shrine.
strings.Rapporte le rôti à Gonguron : il brise l: Take the roast to Gonguron: it breaks the wall and reveals Kayra Mah Shrine.
strings.Remets la glace à Furosa, retourne voir: Put the ice back in Furosa, go back to Pokki and activate Misae Suma Shrine.
strings.Traverse le marais jusqu'au le sanctuair: Cross the marsh to Kuhn Sidajj Shrine without leaving the course.
strings.Utilise la paravoile pour suivre le vent: Use the Paraglider to track the wind and land directly on the slab to reveal Shai Yota Shrine.
strings.Éloigne-toi avant que la foudre frappe l: Stay away before lightning strikes the object and reveals Qukah Nata Shrine.
strings.Rapporte le rôti à Gonguron : il brise l: Take the roast back to Gonguron: it breaks the wall and reveals Gorae Torr Shrine.
strings.Utilise une feuille Korogu pour souffler: Use a Korok leaf to blow into the Flamebreaker pillars according to the sung order and reveal Bareeda Naag Shrine.
strings.Sauvegarder avant sa zone d'activation: Save before entering its activation area
strings.Parle à Erhêt dans le village d'Elimith: Speak to Nebb in Hateno Village and show him the weapon he requests.
strings.Montre successivement l'épée de voyageur: Show him, in order, a Traveler's Sword, Fire Rod, Moblin Club, Duplex Bow, Windcleaver, Ancient Battle Axe+, Frostspear and Ancient Short Sword.
strings.Conserve chaque arme jusqu'à sa présenta: Keep each weapon until you have shown it to him, then return with the Ancient Short Sword to receive the final Diamond reward.
strings.Suis le parcours indiqué sans retirer l': Follow the marked route without unequipping the supplied sword, bow or shield. Use bombs to preserve their durability and avoid setting them on fire.
strings.Vise l'œil pour l'étourdir, puis frappe: Aim at its eye to stun it, then strike its legs or body while it is down.
strings.Frappe le corps ou les jambes pendant sa: Strike its body or legs while it is down, then move away before it slams into the ground.
strings.Brûle ses jambières en bois afin d'expos: Burn its wooden leg guards to expose its legs and leave it vulnerable for longer.
strings.Dispose d'au moins treize cœurs permanen: You need at least thirteen permanent hearts. Hold the action button until you have fully drawn the blade.
strings.Parle à Quill au village Piaf puis retro: Speak to Kheel in Rito Village, find her four sisters and bring the requested Salmon Meunière.
strings.Évite les Gardiens et ouvre avec Polaris: Avoid the Guardians and use Magnesis to open the chest containing the Travel Medallion.
strings.Le flag global de coffre du sanctuaire d: The shrine's global chest-completion flag must be set to true.
strings.Atteins la péninsule d'Uzmi au nord-est: Reach Rist Peninsula in northeastern Akkala and read the stone tablet.
strings.Retrouve les dix autres monuments de pie: Find the other ten stone monuments in the Lanayru region and read each inscription.
strings.Rejoins la source du Courage et cherche: Go to the Spring of Courage and search beneath the stone dragon's right hand.
strings.Parle à Gizan au village Piaf et renseig: Speak to Gesane in Rito Village and ask about the Frost Talus.
strings.Rejoins le village Piaf, parle à Kaï pui: Go to Rito Village, speak to Kaneli, then meet Teba at the Flight Range.
strings.Écoute Asarim dans les bois de Damel et: Listen to Kass in Damel Forest and follow the Dracozu River to the Spring of Courage.
strings.Photographie l'épée géante de la huitièm: Photograph the Eighth Heroine's giant sword in the Gerudo Highlands.
strings.Place la Épée de légende dans son socle: Place the Master Sword in its pedestal in front of the Great Deku Tree and choose an available trial.
strings.Utilise une feuille korogu sur la voile: Use a Korok Leaf on the sail, or use an Octo Balloon and Stasis depending on the terrain.

strings.Observer le déplacement des sphères avan: Watch the movement of the orbs before stepping off each switch
strings.Monte sur le premier interrupteur pour i: Stand on the first switch to tilt the platform and roll the orb into its socket.
strings.Sur les plateformes suivantes, quitte l': On the following platforms, step off the switch at the right moment to launch the orb into its socket.
strings.Emprunte les plateformes mobiles déverro: Ride the moving platforms you have unlocked, then reach the altar after collecting the chest.
strings.Avec Polaris, pose un tonneau métallique: Use Magnesis to place a metal barrel on the final switch, keeping the ramp tilted so you can reach the raised chest.
strings.Parle à Jun puis à Suya au relais du sud: Speak to Jana, then Gleema, at South Akkala Stable.
strings.Apporte une libellule volt, une libellul: Bring an Electric Darner, a Cold Darner and a Warm Darner.
strings.Montre les trois libellules à Jun, donne: Show Jana the three darners, give them to Gleema, then speak to Jana again.
strings.Parle à Coconoa près de la marmite de Co: Speak to Koko near the cooking pot in Kakariko Village and learn that she needs a Swift Carrot.
strings.Achète ou récolte une carotte tempo puis: Buy or gather a Swift Carrot and give it to Koko.
strings.Récolte cinq grenouilles tempo autour de: Collect five Hot-Footed Frogs around ponds or in the rain, or buy them from a merchant.
strings.Récolte cinquante champignons tempo sans: Collect fifty Rushrooms without cooking them.
strings.Lis le journal EX de Lambda dans les rui: Read Misko's EX Journal at Outpost Ruins.
strings.Lis le journal EX de Lambda 2 dans les r: Read Misko's EX Journal 2 at Deya Village Ruins.
strings.Donneur : Journal EX de Lambda 2 - Ruine: Quest giver: Misko's EX Journal 2 - Deya Village Ruins
strings.Arme de Gardien 1.0 ou 2.0 selon l'équip: Guardian weapon or Guardian weapon+ depending on its equipment
strings.Donneur : Bourgette sait tout spécial EX: Quest giver: Super Rumor Mill EX: Volume 3 - Highland Stable
strings.Lis le Bourgette sait tout spécial EX n°: Read Super Rumor Mill EX: Volume 1 at Woodland Stable.
Read Super Rumor Mill EX: Volume 2 at South Akkala Stable.
Read Super Rumor Mill EX: Volume 3 at Highland Stable.
Read Super Rumor Mill EX: Volume 4 at Riverside Stable.
